Select target ChEMBL ID, target name, target type, protein accession, and protein sequence for all single-protein targets. Join target_dictionary to target_components and component_sequences. Filter target_dictionary.target_type to SINGLE PROTEIN. Return target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, protein_sequence. Sort by target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, protein_sequence.
